lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, primarily concentrated along the mid-lateral line.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical high-intensity bands intersect with horizontal carinae, with circular spots positioned at the intersections forming a series of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges on the upper flank showing a sharp luminance gradient transition from light on the dorsal edge to shadow on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Significant concentration of small commensal teleost fish clustered around the anterior-ventral region and mouth.
